title: Compact logs, retain the constraint
lesson: Summarize redundant history while retaining requirements, then retrieve the evidence needed for the next model invocation. A generated patch still needs checking.
transcript: 0.0–7.7s: KEEP API, the null-crash task and api.ts:42 trace occupy an illustrative 8k-token context. Three repeated logs raise the displayed count to 10k, 13k and 15k of 16k.

7.7–11.0s: Redundant logs fade and become summary: null input. The unchanged constraint, task and trace remain; with the summary the illustrative total is 9k. The constraint and trace are highlighted.
12.2–15.3s: A callers? request reaches Repository. caller.ts returns and is recorded as caller.ts:18; the context rises to 11k.
17.3–22.9s: The selected context reaches Model. After processing, an amber Patch? candidate appears. No test or correctness verdict is shown.
23.0–25.0s: The complete scene fades to black; the exact decoded first and last frames match.
limitations: Token counts and 16k capacity are illustrative, not a named model configuration or measured compression ratio.
The example shows a successful selection of retained details; summaries can omit requirements. Inspect the summary against its sources.
The final Patch? is a candidate, not a tested result.

corrections.change: Corrected 5k/7k totals to 9k/11k so retaining the original 8k plus a summary does not consume fewer tokens than the unchanged original.
Replaced the unsupported green correctness tick with an amber Patch? candidate.
